Ambiance

The continuous atmospheric layer. Use this for wind, city hum, room tone, or background textures.

Foley

Specific physical actions captured in sync with movement. Use this for footsteps, cloth rustle, or objects being handled.

SFX

Designed or synthetic sounds. Use this for abstract elements like whooshes, UI clicks, cinematic impacts, or risers.

Direct level control for the audio embedded in your source video. Balance original location sound with your new synthesized design.

Master Gain

The final output summing bus. Adjusts the ultimate loudness of your entire mix (Ambiance + Foley + SFX + Reference) before final export.
